output.reason: PP 36/2025 extends the reduced JKK (work accident insurance) contribution under PP 7/2025 for certain labour-intensive industry companies up to the January 2026 contribution. The extension covers contribution months August 2025 onward, following the original period. JKK premiums paid by the employer form part of the permanent employee's gross income for PPh 21. Extending the reduced rate therefore changes the gross income component, and so the PPh 21 base, for the affected employees during the extended period.
